An HDMI RF modulator is a device used to convert an HDMI signal into a radio frequency (RF) signal that can be distributed over coaxial cables. This conversion allows HDMI signals, typically used for high-definition audio and video transmission between devices like Blu-ray players, gaming consoles, or set-top boxes, to be transmitted over existing coaxial cable infrastructure.
